app.title: Despacho
map.description: Map of {neighborhood} with {restaurants} restaurants, {riders} riders and {customers} customers waiting
orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: No orders yet. The first one comes in a few seconds.
riders.title: Riders
riders.name: Rider {number}
riders.hintByEta: Sorted by who reaches the customer first.
riders.deliveryLate: Reaches the customer in {minutes} min: late
topbar.ratingValue: Shift average: {rating} of {max} stars. You win with {goal}.
topbar.ratingNone: No stars yet: they come with the first delivery. You win with {goal}.
results.thresholds: You win with {win} stars or more; below {lose}, you lose.
topbar.timeLabel: Game time: {time}. The shift ends at {end}
map.pickRider: Now pick a rider: here, on the map or with keys 1–9.
map.closestRiders: Free riders, the one who delivers first on top (minutes to the customer):
riders.hintPickFirst: Pick a rider, then a restaurant with orders on the map.
riders.hintPickedRider: Now tap a restaurant with "!" on the map: the rider picks up its most urgent order.
riders.noBattery: Not enough battery for this trip: if you pick them, they go back to base to recharge.
orders.addHint: Shift + click adds an order from a nearby restaurant.
map.pickedCount: {count} orders on the trip: the rider takes the ones waiting here. Shift + click leaves one out.
selection.pickRider: Pick a rider to take it.
selection.reassign: Going with rider {rider}. Pick another one to reassign it (it loses {minutes} min of its deadline).
selection.onItsWay: Already on its way with rider {rider}: you can only call the customer.
selection.callTitle: Calls left this shift: {calls}. Key L.
riders.hintReassign: Pick another free rider for order #{number}.
riders.hintOnTheWay: That order already left the restaurant: it can't be reassigned.
sound.unmuteTitle: Turn the sound back on (key M)
levels.intro: Each shift opens with {stars} stars or more in the one before. An average of {stars} over the three shifts opens the next neighborhood.
levels.lunch.name: Lunch
levels.lunch.tagline: A quiet noon to get to know the neighborhood.
levels.dinner.name: Dinner
levels.dinner.tagline: More orders, shorter deadlines and one more rider.
levels.friday.name: Friday night
levels.friday.tagline: The busiest night of the week. You won't make it to everything.
levels.vesterbro_lunch.name: Lunch
levels.vesterbro_lunch.tagline: Kødbyen cooks for half the neighborhood. Group orders from the same place.
levels.vesterbro_dinner.name: Dinner
levels.vesterbro_dinner.tagline: More orders from Kødbyen and two bikes that carry two at a time.
levels.vesterbro_friday.name: Friday night
levels.vesterbro_friday.tagline: Kødbyen is packed. A trip with two orders counts double.
levels.frederiksberg_lunch.name: Lunch
levels.frederiksberg_lunch.tagline: Wide avenues and faraway customers: here comes the motorbike.
levels.frederiksberg_dinner.name: Dinner
levels.frederiksberg_dinner.tagline: The motorbike flies on long trips; the bike still wins the short ones.
levels.frederiksberg_friday.name: Friday night
levels.frederiksberg_friday.tagline: Six riders, orders all over the neighborhood. Choose well who goes far.
briefing.goal: You win with {win} stars or more.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.rider: Pick a rider (or send them with the order picked)
shortcuts.addOrder: Leave out an order of the same restaurant, or add one from a nearby restaurant
shortcuts.call: Call the customer of the order picked
shortcuts.cancel: Cancel the selection; with nothing picked, opens the pause menu
riders.capacityTitle: Carries up to {count} orders at a time
shortcuts.nextOrder: Go through the order queue, from most to least urgent
shortcuts.drag: Drag a free rider onto an order (or the other way round) to send them
map.toggleAttribution: Show or hide the map credits
radio.title: Shift radio
pause.title: Paused
results.lostTitle: What took away from your average
results.money.title: Shift money
results.tipLate: Tip: send first what's due first. With ↓ you go through the queue from most to least urgent.
results.tipCold: Tip: food gets cold while it waits. Send whoever reaches the restaurant just as it leaves the kitchen.
results.tipCancelled: Tip: a cancelled order is worth 1 star. Before losing it, call the customer (L) or reassign the order.
results.tipNone: A perfect shift! Not a single star lost.
vehicles.bike.note: Uses bike lanes and can carry several orders.
vehicles.skateboard.note: Cuts through pedestrian streets; slower on cobblestones.
vehicles.e_scooter.note: The fastest; can't go into pedestrian streets.
orders.suggestionLabel: Send order #{order} with rider {rider} ({vehicle}, reaches the customer in {minutes} min{late})
guide.wait: Wait a moment: the first order reaches the queue on the left in a few seconds.
guide.pickOrder: ← Pick an order from the queue (click or ↓). The ones on top are due first.
guide.pickRider: Now pick who takes it → (click or their number). On top is the one who reaches the customer first.
conditions.title: Shift conditions: the light, and later the weather and the city's events
vehicles.rollers.note: Goes into the building without parking; slower on cobblestones.
vehicles.cargo_bike.note: Carries up to 5 orders in one trip, but it's slower than the bike.
events.office_order.name: Office order
events.office_order.effect: An office places {count} orders at once with one restaurant, for desks a few blocks apart, with {minutes} min to deliver. A cargo bike takes them all in one trip.
vehicles.motorcycle.note: Flies down the avenues, but doesn't use bike lanes and parks at every stop.
briefing.zone: {count} of the {total} restaurants are together in {zone}: with Shift + click, a bike takes two orders from the same place in one trip.
levels.neighborhoodLocked: {name}, locked. Opens with an average of {stars} stars in {previous}.
levels.areaLockedIntro: Opens with an average of {stars} stars over the three shifts of {previous}. A shift not played counts as zero.
levels.lockedArea: Opens with an average of {stars} in {previous}
briefing.far: Customers live far away: {km} km or more from the restaurant. On the avenues, the motorbike gets there first even though it parks.
garage.intro: Pick each rider's vehicle. Up to {max} go out this shift. Each one costs its vehicle, paid at the end of the shift.
garage.hireNote: This shift's suggested fleet has {count} riders. Hiring one more is for good.
garage.tooExpensive: The fleet costs more than the cash you have. Pick cheaper vehicles or take riders off: with just one you can always go out.
garage.onCredit: A single rider goes out without the money to pay them: your cash will go negative.
events.rain.name: Rain
events.rain.effect: Everyone is slower (skateboards, rollerblades and e-scooters much more) and {demand} % more orders come in.
events.wind.name: Wind
events.wind.effect: Blowing {from}: bikes, skateboards and rollerblades go faster with it and slower against it, and pick other streets. The e-scooter and the motorbike don't feel it.
map.wind: Wind {from}: the arrow shows where it blows.
events.marathon.name: Marathon
events.marathon.effect: {route} is closed: nobody gets through and routes go around it. Customers along the course still get their order, on foot for the last stretch.
events.strike.name: Strike
events.strike.effect: Nobody goes out by {vehicle} this shift: the fleet is rebuilt with the other vehicles (see the garage).
garage.strike: There's a strike: nobody goes out by {vehicle} this shift.
restart.question: Erase the whole game? You lose the stars, the money, the riders you hired and the garage fleets. This can't be undone.
garage.courseLabel: Pay a course for {rider}: one level up for {cost} (and a higher salary)
map.firstFree: First to be free: Rider {rider}, in ~{minutes} min.
weather.swapped: {name}: the suggested fleet goes out by {to} instead of {slow}, which slow down a lot.
weather.keep: {name}: {slow} gets much slower. Better to go out by {to}.
results.outcome.closeNeighborhood: Almost: you need an average of {goal} in the neighborhood to open {neighborhood}
results.barLabel: Average {rating} of {max}. Below {lose} you lose; with {win} or more you win.
map.tripWith: With rider {rider}, in this order (minutes to each customer):
map.customerStop: Customer of order #{number} · stop {stop} of the trip
guide.waitNext: Wait a moment: the next order reaches the queue on the left in a few seconds.
language.label: Language
title.tagline: You run the dispatch desk: orders come in, you pick who takes them and plan the trips so the food gets there hot and on time.
